articles.title: The future of testing: Autonomous agents, ethical AI, and human oversight
articles.summary: The evolution of software testing is imperative as AI and self-adaptive systems introduce probabilistic behaviors that challenge traditional deterministic testing methods. articles.takeaway: Software testing must evolve to ensure trust in AI systems, focusing on ethical accountability and broader quality metrics.
